decisions.reason: The dietary supplement range supports the firm's stated consumer-health portfolio expansion and was given sustained standalone visibility, suggesting it became a strategic platform rather than a short-lived test.
The skin and hair supplement fits the pharmacy-led OTC/supplement channel, stayed prominently presented after launch, and broadens the Trivital-style consumer offering with limited development risk.
The joint-health supplement moved from a mention at launch to its own page, indicating enough traction to justify retaining it within the firm's growing consumer-health portfolio.
The immune supplement was actively promoted as an innovative addition and fits a strong pharmacy-based consumer-health segment, so it is worth keeping as part of the expanded supplement line.

The generic blood-pressure product appears less strategically embedded, faced an early product issue, and in a flat industry a large expanding firm would likely reallocate resources from a troubled, lower-margin generic launch to stronger core and development projects.

The OTC migraine triptan has a clear standalone market position with pharmacies and patients, and it matches the firm's goal of adding new consumer-health products with better differentiation than a commodity generic.
